title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-openai-compat-and-improved-errors
author: Priya Menon
description: This PR adds JSON Schema-based structured output support to the API response_format surface with a strict validation mode and improved error reporting compatible with OpenAI-style responses. Motivation: customers need deterministic, machine-readable outputs and clearer validation errors when models deviate from a schema. This change implements: 1) API: new response_format JSON_SCHEMA and parameters {schema:string, strict:boolean, allow_partial:boolean} (SDKs updated to accept the flags and pass through). 2) Server-side: best-effort pre-validation during streaming, final strict validation pass at completion, deterministic reserialization for OpenAI compatibility (choices[0].message.content with content-type). 3) Validation: jsonschema-backed validator that reports structured errors (path, schema_keyword, expected, actual, suggestion) and an error envelope compatible with existing API error shapes. 4) Streaming stability: buffering and token gating when response_format=JSON_SCHEMA and strict=true to avoid emitting malformed partial JSON; fallback to chunked text with validation error metadata when model output is irrecoverable. 5) Compatibility: when client requests openai_compat=true, we return top-level choices/usage fields and place schema validation errors under error->type="schema_validation" and error->details as a list. 6) Tests: unit and integration tests for validator, streaming gate, and SDK behavior. 7) Docs & examples: added quickstart and examples showing strict vs. permissive modes and migration guidance. NOTE: Description includes implementation details, migration notes, and guidance for operators about throttling and KPIs (validation error rate).
commits: - 7 commits: initial schema validator and tests; add response_format parsing; implement streaming buffer/gate; wire validator into request pipeline; SDK param plumbing; docs and examples; unit test fixes for edge cases
review_thread: - Luca: requested clearer error payload for validation failures (show path and suggestion). - Author: updated error envelope and added suggestion field. - Meera: asked for streaming gating timeout and fallback path; author added gated timeout and behavior to return best-effort partial with validation error metadata. - Daniel: requested OpenAI compatibility semantics for choices/usage; author added a compatibility layer that populates choices[0].message.content and usage estimation. - CI: initial test failure on flakiness in grpc streaming test; fixed by increasing buffer timeout and adding retry in test. - Final: approved by Luca and Meera after fixes.
release_notes: - Added JSON Schema structured output (response_format=JSON_SCHEMA) with strict validation mode and improved error reporting. - Streaming now buffers structured output when strict=true to avoid malformed JSON emissions. - OpenAI compatibility layer populates choices and error envelope for schema validation errors. See docs/api/response_format.md for migration steps.
notes: Operator guidance: monitor the schema_validation_error_rate metric and set a conservative buffer timeout for latency-sensitive routes. Recommend starting with strict=false and collecting validation metrics before enabling strict=true in production.
